title: 第1616章 回到渡硬国
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天王站在城主府上指挥：【稳住，其他兄弟不要传送来了，组织好进来支援！】

【支援？哈哈，你们铺开那么大的摊子，想这么短时间内收拢？不可能！】

天使领域的人狂笑。

不是说人来了就能守住，还要加状态，还要摆阵。

不然一盘散沙，传过来也是送死。

事实确实如此。

传送阵就在广场上。

大商的人刚传送到，就会被人围攻，瞬秒。

他们来，和送装备没什么区别。

天王脸皮颤抖：【不要传送了。】

可惜，人太多了，这么乱想要指挥很难很难。

全世界都以为，这场战斗要结束了。

就在这时候，传送阵光芒闪过。

林风的身影出现在传送阵上。

他还没反应过来，无数技能一股脑的砸了过来。

【这里有个肉的，居然没死。】

【管他呢，继续弄他！】

技能太多了，天使领域的人竟然没有第一时间看到林风名字。

打了许久，突然有人发现。

【不对~~商天子，是商天子！！】

【商天子来了。】

【商天子来了。】

这五个字，瞬间响彻整个城市，也传遍所有直播间。

天使领域的米迦勒，拉斐尔更是第一时间知道。

天长老更是瞪大双眼：【怎么可能？商天子从蓬莱岛下来了？】

【难道他已经得到突破9重天的方法了？】

威尔斯连忙

想看林风的等级实在太简单了。

世界排行榜永远的第一名，也只有他一个人是8重天。

天长老看了一眼威尔斯，像看傻子一样：【没有那么快突破，9重天没有那么简单，他肯定掌握什么了。】

林风的等级高高挂在排行榜上。

一直以来，全都是8重天0%。

没有丝毫进度。

聪明人不难猜测突破到9重天有限制。

威尔斯双眼微眯：【那就问出来。】

【他会说吗？】

【那就看我们手里的筹码多不多。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The King of Heaven stood on the city lord's palace and commanded: [Hold still, other brothers should not teleport here, organize and come in for support!】

【Support?Haha, you spread out such a big stall and want to close it in such a short time?impossible!】

The people in the angel realm laughed wildly.

It doesn't mean that people can defend it when they come, but they also need to increase their status and set up formations.

Otherwise, if a dish of loose sand is passed over, it will also lead to death.

And indeed it is.

The teleportation array is in the square.

As soon as Dashang's people arrived, they were besieged in seconds.

When they come, it's no different than sending equipment.

The King's face trembled: [Stop teleporting.】

Unfortunately, there are too many people, and it is very difficult to direct them in such a chaotic manner.

The whole world thought that this battle was coming to an end.

At this moment, the teleportation array flashed with light.

Lin Feng's figure appeared on the teleportation array.

Before he could react, countless skills were thrown at him.

[There is a fleshy guy here who is actually not dead.】

[Whatever, keep messing with him!】

There are so many skills that no one in the Angel Realm saw Lin Feng’s name immediately.

After fighting for a long time, someone suddenly noticed.

[No~~Shang Emperor, it’s Shang Emperor!!】

[The Emperor Shang is here.】

[The Emperor Shang is here.】

These five words instantly resounded throughout the city and spread throughout all live broadcast rooms.

Michael and Raphael in the angel realm were the first to know.

Elder Tian’s eyes widened: [How is that possible?Emperor Shang came down from Penglai Island?】

[Has he already found a way to break through the ninth heaven?】

Wells hurriedly

It's too easy to see Lin Feng's level.

He is always number one in the world rankings, and he is the only one who is ranked 8th.

Elder Tian glanced at Wells as if he were a fool: [It is not that fast to break through. The ninth level is not that simple. He must have mastered something.】

Lin Feng's level is high on the ranking list.

All the time, it’s all 8th level 0%.

There is no progress at all.

It is not difficult for a smart person to guess that there are limits to breaking through to the ninth level.

Wells narrowed his eyes slightly: [Then ask.】

[Will he say it?】

[Then it depends on whether we have many chips in our hands.】
